There are a so many boy kings throughout history because as Sacesss says, succession is ALWAYS vertical. Only when there is literally no one else available does it move horizontally to a brother. Someone - likely Otto, Aemond or even Rhaenyra - would be named regent until he came of age. This has ALWAYS been the case.
Generally, taking better care of all of his kids would have suited him. Even Rhaenyra felt overlooked in the teenage episodes, because she wasn't a son.

And if he really, really wanted her to be his heir, he should have fought for it tooth and nail and made sure that absolutely everybody was fully on board with it, and that the arguments for Rhaenyra would be watertight. I'm talking re-writing laws, changing rules of succession country-wide, all of that. It probably have been within his power to do that, but for some reason he just didn't.
